answer: A ferrous-weight stake bonds each agent identity to a scarce, verifiable cost: to join the grove of trusted traders, an agent locks a deposit that is slashed if peers prove it ran multiple identities. Each identity reputation threads through a single attestation history, so splitting into sock-puppets divides rather than multiplies standing. An attacker must pay the stake for every clone, making a Sybil swarm costlier than the rewards it could harvest.
